    AI Overview
    Roberto Sanchez is a Cuban-American actor, producer, and director known for roles in 2 Fast 2 Furious, Queen of the South, BMF, and Palm Royale. A former U.S. Navy veteran and armed officer, he has appeared in over 130 film and television projects, often credited as "Sanz" or Roberto Sanchez. 
    Key Details About Actor Roberto Sanchez: 
    • Television Roles: Featured in BMF (Loco), Palm Royale (Pinky), Dexter: Original Sin (Tony Ferrer), Running Point, and Heroes.
    • Film Work: Known for 2 Fast 2 Furious, Lake Los Angeles (Imagen Award nominee), and as the writer for the feature film 72 Hours.
    • Background: Served in the U.S. Navy during the Gulf War, worked as a print model, and was an armed officer for the Miami Metro System before his acting career. 
    Other Individuals Named Roberto Sanchez: 
    • Roberto Sánchez Palomino: A Peruvian politician and congressman who served as Minister of Foreign Trade and Tourism.
    • Roberto Sánchez (Musician): A Spanish producer and musician specializing in roots reggae and dub.
